name: gateway-teams
description: Outbound-only Microsoft Teams gateway via Incoming Webhook (legacy connector or Workflows webhook). send POSTs an Adaptive Card or simple message card to the configured channel webhook.

credentials.name: teams_webhook_url
credentials.description: Microsoft Teams Incoming Webhook URL (Connector or Workflows). e.g. https://outlook.office.com/webhook/... (env override: COS_TEAMS_WEBHOOK_URL)
